translationRepairs: In the third year of Guangxu he was transferred to the An-Xiang-Jing-Qin circuit.
In the third year of Guangxu he was transferred to the An-Xiang-Jing-Yun circuit.
s0005 安襄荊鄖道 ends in 荊鄖; 鄖 is Yun, not Qin. The idiomatic Qin misreads the circuit name; Yun restores the Chinese place.
In the third year of Guangxu he was transferred to the An-Xiang-Jing-Qin circuit intendancy.
In the third year of Guangxu he was transferred to the An-Xiang-Jing-Yun circuit intendancy.
s0005 荊鄖 is Jing-Yun; the literal’s Qin is the same place-name error as in the idiomatic and must be corrected.
Earlier, when the French attacked Thuan An, Vietnam had not yet been beaten yet still rushed to sue for peace.
Earlier, when the French attacked Thuan An, Vietnam had not yet been beaten but still rushed to sue for peace.
s0018 越未敗，遽乞和 contrasts not yet defeated with hasty peace-seeking; the doubled “yet…yet still” is ungrammatical, and “but still” correctly marks that contrast without changing sense.
He passed the provincial examination in the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang and was the son of Instructor Tang.
He passed the provincial examination in the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang and was the son of Tang Xunfang.
s0058 訓方子 names the father as 訓方 (Xunfang); s0059 訓方督師金口 confirms it is a personal name, not an occupational “Instructor Tang.”
In the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang he became a provincial graduate; he was the son of Instructor Tang.
In the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang he became a provincial graduate; he was the son of Tang Xunfang.
s0058 訓方 is the father’s given name Xunfang; the literal “Instructor Tang” invents a title and must be replaced with Tang Xunfang.
When the French seized Vietnam from China, he was ordered to Kaifeng on defense duty and was appointed governor on the spot before the army.
When the French seized Vietnam from China, he was ordered to Kaihua on defense duty and was appointed governor on the spot before the army.
s0109 赴開化防守 names 開化 (Kaihua), not 開封 (Kaifeng); the idiomatic place must be corrected.
The French seized our Vietnam; he was ordered to go to Kaifeng to defend, and was at once appointed governor before the army.
The French seized our Vietnam; he was ordered to go to Kaihua to defend, and was at once appointed governor before the army.
s0109 開化 is Kaihua; the literal Kaifeng is a different city (開封) and the proposed Kaihua matches the Chinese.
